---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem would this solve?**
The situation you are in and why the current behaviour makes it hard. This matters more than the
proposed solution, and often leads to a simpler one.

**What would you like to happen?**
Your proposed change, if you have one in mind.

**Which part does this touch?**
Diagnostics and agent tools / investigations / scheduled scans / trends / topology / onboarding /
deployment and teardown / something else.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Including doing nothing, or solving it outside this project.

**Anything else**
Whether you would be willing to contribute it, and anything about your environment that shapes the
requirement, such as engine version, fleet size or a compliance constraint.
